notes: One הָיוּ governs both coordinated subjects and the ASV writes 'were' twice; both occurrences belong to its one discontinuous unit (rule 25). The competing reading gives the first 'were' to עַל as a gapped-clause copula under rules 34 and 49.
MACULA reads חֵילֵךְ as a place name; the ASV's 'thine army' is aligned to that token as a whole, with the waw taking the 'with' the ASV wrote for it (rule 14).
